verdict.rationale: Ledgy is an equity-management SaaS with a documented OAuth service-account API, so an official CLI is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a CLI tool, command-line client or terminal workflow. The API operations (auth, companyCaptable, companyTransactions) are developer building blocks, not a CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
